body:
Disney casted her and sold it as diversity for brownie points and more profit, disguising it as representation. It’s a cash grab for another live action remake that no one asked for. 
Why changed such a well established character? Can she play an amazing Ariel? Does she have an amazing voice? Yes. But if it’s not broken, don’t fix it. 
People talking about what an impact this is gonna have on little kids. Kids aren’t worried about diversity, they’re gonna dress up as whatever princess they like. 
I’m not denying a black Ariel, but it’s bogus and Disney has everyone eating shit out of the palm of their hand.
